summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Brenmiller Energy Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release announcing a waiver from the European Investment Bank (EIB) deferring a ~€1.7 million loan payment due July 28, 2026 through September 15, 2026, and ongoing negotiations toward a full settlement expected to reduce debt and strengthen the balance sheet in support of the BrenX growth strategy. No price, premium, or board advisor is stated. The filing describes a debt restructuring rather than an M&A transaction. Watch for definitive settlement terms and impact on liquidity.
